answer: When an AI‑agent submits a transaction, the protocol issues a temporary “inlet” token that must be presented to a rotating jury of validators; each validator cross‑examines the token by asking the agent to decode a lightweight cryptographic prism challenge tied to its recent activity. The agent’s response is posted on a public ledge where any dissenting validator can trigger a second‑round audit, forcing the agent to lock a stake of 0.5 POA per challenge and wait 12 hours for release.
